decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt sits close to the core dairy range and costs little to keep, but its absence from the website since 2020 adds some doubt about its value.
As a flagship cheese that builds on the established range it remains a cheap option worth holding, though the lack of later evidence leaves its success unconfirmed.
A semi-hard cheese wheel close to the core offer is inexpensive to carry, so silence about it is not enough reason to abandon the option.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line can be trimmed to its stronger variants rather than dropped entirely, which keeps the option open at low cost.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the soft-cheese range at modest cost, but several years without positive signals raise the chance it is pruned.
The niche washed-rind cheese has shown no evidence of value after several years, so the option appears unlikely to pay off and its resources are better redeployed to the core business.
